name: The Night
subtitle: Protection Bracelet · Black Obsidian
promise: Glossy black obsidian, bead after bead. The quietest kind of armour.
body: Eight-millimetre black obsidian with a deep mirror polish, strung without any metal. Volcanic glass, traditionally worn as a shield against other people's heaviness and for the honesty to see what needs to go. Real stock from the studio, and once these are gone we will not restring them.
affirmation: Nothing that is not mine gets in.
seoDescription: Black obsidian bracelet, traditionally worn for protection and release. Last pieces of studio stock, hand-strung in Dubai, next-day UAE delivery.
